question: Who became the first bowler in T20 International history to take an eight-wicket haul, setting a world record in December 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonam Yeshey.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **Bhutan’s Sonam Yeshey scripted history by becoming the first bowler to take eight wickets in a T20 International match.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Sonam Yeshey recorded extraordinary figures of 8 for 7 in four overs against Myanmar.**
 
• He achieved the feat in the third T20I at Gelephu, helping bowl Myanmar out for just 45.
 
• The spell included a maiden over and came at an economy rate of 1.80.
 
• The performance sealed Bhutan’s 82-run win and an unassailable 3-0 lead in the five-match series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Previous T20I Bowling Records__

 __
 
• The previous best figures in men’s T20Is were seven wickets in an innings.
 
• Syazrul Idrus took 7 for 8 against China in 2023.
 
• Ali Dawood claimed 7 for 19 against Bhutan in 2025.
 
 
 
• Sonam Yeshey Profile__
 __
 
• Born on December 3, 2003.
 
• A slow left-arm orthodox spinner who bats right-handed.
 
• Made his T20I debut in July 2022 and has taken 37 wickets in 34 matches.
 
 
 
• Significance of the Feat__
 
 
• First eight-wicket haul in T20 International history.
 
• Also unprecedented across all men’s T20 cricket formats.
 
• Marked a historic milestone for Bhutan cricket on the global stage.
